tests: tests/unit/tool-fences.test.ts::amc_ tool results that carry outside text come back fenced > amc_run: a worker's reply in status
findings.note: the worker's reply also reaches the orchestrator through the host's turn-end message in runs.ts, which is not a tool result and was left unchanged; the mapped test covers only the status action, and a base-failing test of the changed lines would not reach that unchanged path

notes: Five failure tests are generated by a loop with a template-literal title; Vitest prints each as the bare tool name (amc_run, amc_pins, amc_kb, amc_code, amc_ado). Strict marks come from describe titles echoing MUST wording, not MUST numbers. Review found only in rv-gaps-1.jsonl final message (table row 2).
